options.name: V em movimento
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one refined minimalist professional logo for the exact brand name "VitalStep", a premium smart-shoe biometric platform connecting human movement, health monitoring and energy.
Asset type: final flat logo concept, clean high-resolution landscape brand presentation, 1536x1024 composition.
Scene/backdrop: absolutely solid deep navy black #05080F, edge to edge.
Style: exceptionally crisp flat vector-like graphic design, restrained geometry, strong silhouette, balanced negative space, expensive considered brand identity.
Layout: a single compact standalone symbol centered above a single wordmark, generously spaced, overall centered. Symbol about 180px tall and wordmark about 490px wide in a 1536x1024 canvas. Optical alignment and precise spacing. Plenty of empty space.
Wordmark text verbatim: "VitalStep", exactly that capitalization and spelling. Set as one unbroken word in a contemporary geometric sans-serif similar to Space Grotesk medium or semibold. All letters soft white #F2F6F7, carefully kerned, clean and easy to read.
Allowed palette only: cyan #20D8F8, blue #3C83F6, white #F2F6F7, background #05080F. Use solid fills only.
Constraints: just one logo and one wordmark. No slogan, no option number, no labels, no hex codes, no extra lettering. No glow, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no mockup, no 3D, no border, no busy scientific circuitry, no existing famous logo imitation. Simplicity and small-size legibility matter.
Specific direction 1, "V em movimento": Design a custom bold abstract V monogram built from exactly two substantial angled ribbon-like geometric strokes with subtly rounded terminals. Cyan dominant, one blue stroke. A precise asymmetric offset at the top suggests two legs taking a forward stride. The V must read immediately, feel balanced and elegant, with a wide open inner negative space. A unique clean silhouette, no extra lines, no arrowheads, no circular enclosure. Athletic momentum with premium healthcare technology restraint.
